text:
Rae: quick brain dump on the new model-catalog compare row mock. main probs: too many solid badges, pin icon is ambiguous, and 'signature' filter confuses new users. figma: https://figma.redwood/compare-lite

Cal: agree. suggestion: introduce a single compact summary chip (e.g., 'Perf • 28ms') that can expand inline to reveal cost/accuracy chips. reduces clutter for scanning.

Mei: pin scope: current mock seems workspace-shared. i'd prefer per-user by default with an explicit 'Share pin' action in the pin menu that shows a tiny confirmation. avoids accidental global changes.

Jordan: accessibility: chips at 11px white-on-color fail contrast for amber/green. recommend outlined chips with dark label or dark text on light chips. i'll run quick axe checks.

A11yBot: automated note: amber #FFB84D on white text -> contrast 2.6:1 (fail). suggested: dark text #3B2E00 or outlined token. also flagged missing aria-describedby on pin buttons.

Rae: copy tweak idea: change pin label from 'Pinned - v2' to 'Pinned (you) — v2' and for shared 'Pinned (workspace) — v2' to make ownership explicit. also rename filter 'signature' -> 'Variant signature' or split into 'Family' + 'Signature'.

Cal: density toggle?: per-user compact/comfy preference. compact shows summary chip + icon, comfy expands all chips. persist in account settings.

Mei: hover/focus parity: expand summary chip on hover after 120ms and immediately on keyboard focus. respect prefers-reduced-motion. add aria-expanded on the chip button and aria-live for status changes.

Jordan: visual idea: a thin left-color bar for perf band and light outlined chips — gives color cue without heavy blocks. will mock.

Rae: proposed decisions: 1) switch to outlined/dark-text chips to fix contrast, 2) add compact summary chip that expands on hover/focus, 3) default pin = per-user with an optional share toggle + confirmation, 4) per-user density toggle persisted, 5) legend with perf thresholds collapsed by default and keyboard-expandable. anyone object?

Cal: no objections. i'll add legend copy for thresholds and link to docs.

Mei: i'll prototype pin menu with share confirmation and update aria labels.

Jordan: posting compact mock in ~2h with left-color bar + outlined chips + motion-reduced variant.

A11yBot: reminder: update design tokens for outlined chip states in /shared/design-tokens and include aria-describedby on the pin control.

Rae: thanks team. keeping this thread open until mocks + a11y pass. :thumbsup:
